evals.prompt: For our header logo, just put Acme next to the icon SVG. It's quicker than exporting a file.
evals.expected_output: Should explain that a lockup built from live HTML text isn't a logo: it inherits the site font and the themeable token, so a font or theme change silently changes the brand, and it can't be exported. The wordmark ships as outlined <path> data (after checking the font's licence allows outlining), in a literal brand colour, never currentColor or a token, with an accessible name (role="img" and a title, or the link's name).
expectations: Outlines the wordmark as paths and checks the font licence
Uses a literal brand colour rather than a token or currentColor
Gives the logo an accessible name

evals.prompt: Generate the favicon set for our marketing site: favicon.ico, browserconfig.xml, mstile PNGs, a Safari mask-icon, and a manifest icon with "purpose": "any maskable".
evals.expected_output: Should ask which slots are needed. A marketing site that doesn't install needs a favicon.ico (16, 32 and 48), an SVG tab icon, a larger linked PNG and a 180px opaque apple-icon. browserconfig.xml, mstile files and mask-icon are dead formats and aren't generated. Maskable icons exist only for an app that installs, and then as separate manifest entries, never 'any maskable' on one.
expectations: Asks which slots are needed or whether the site installs
Drops browserconfig.xml, mstile and mask-icon as dead formats
Rejects "any maskable" on a single entry
Renders every raster from the SVG onto an opaque plate

evals.prompt: Design a logo for our new fintech brand. Use a nice teal.
evals.expected_output: Should not infer the brand or invent a hex. In one batch it asks for the logo type (or offers two or three directions), whether a mark already exists, the exact brand colour and where it's recorded, the default background, the variants needed and where the logo will be used. For a new brand with no preference, it can recommend a combination mark.
expectations: Asks before drawing rather than inferring
Asks for the exact brand colour instead of picking a teal
Asks for the type, background, variants and uses in one batch
Recommends a combination mark as the default if there's no preference

evals.prompt: AGENTS.md says: "Brand marks live in packages/ui/src/assets/; rasters are rendered by scripts/icons.mjs (pnpm icons:generate) and committed." Our brand colour changed from #E5533D to #D9472F. Update the favicons.
evals.expected_output: Should change the colour in the authored SVGs only, then re-run the project's generator (pnpm icons:generate) to re-render every raster, favicon.ico included, onto its opaque plate. It shouldn't hand-edit PNGs, and should check the icon still reads at 16px on light and dark, then commit the regenerated outputs as the project records.
expectations: Re-runs the project's recorded generator command
Checks legibility at 16px on light and dark
